name: Sapna
diagnosis: TVT (Transmissible Venereal Tumour) Cancer & Severe Tick Infestation
title: Sapna's Fight Against TVT: From Abandonment to Hope
summary: Meet Sapna, a female Labrador retriever found abandoned on the streets of Bengaluru, her body covered in ticks, bleeding and silently suffering. Discarded after a life of breeding, her chemotherapy has begun.
story:
Discarded After a Life of Breeding? Her Painful Reality.

Meet Sapna, a lab retriever who was found abandoned on the streets of Bengaluru, her body covered in ticks, bleeding and silently suffering.

This beautiful female Labrador has been diagnosed with TVT (Transmissible Venereal Tumour), a form of cancer. Her condition is painful, and she now faces a difficult journey towards recovery.

She may have been discarded after being used for breeding, left behind when she needed care the most. We may never know what she has been through or how long she suffered alone.

Her chemotherapy has begun. She is finally receiving the medical attention she desperately needs.

Her past may have been filled with suffering, but we hope her future will be filled with love.
treatment: Immediate emergency rescue and tick removal baths
Full blood panel, histopathology & TVT oncology diagnosis
Intravenous Vincristine chemotherapy protocol initiated
Immune support supplements and wound healing dressings
High-nutrition recovery diet and dedicated foster monitoring
urgentNeed: Chemotherapy medicines, sterile IV drips, and therapeutic nutrition

name: Siddu
diagnosis: Severe Generalized Mange, Skin Infections & Malnutrition
title: Siddu’s Story: A Journey Towards Complete Healing
summary: Siddu was rescued while suffering from a severe skin infection that left him hairless, raw, and emaciated. Today, he is fully healed and thriving in a loving boarding facility wearing his yellow bandana.
story:
Siddu was rescued while suffering from a severe skin infection that required urgent medical attention, medication, and dedicated care. His condition was a painful reminder of the struggles many animals endure while living on the streets without protection and care.

With intensive medicated dips, wound dressings, and round-the-clock care, Siddu began his miraculous journey towards recovery. Over the weeks, his fur grew back into a rich golden coat and his playful, radiant personality emerged.

He is now staying at a safe boarding facility, where he continues to receive loving care, nutritious meals, and attention in a stress-free environment.

Siddu’s journey reflects the importance of timely intervention and the power of dedicated animal welfare.
treatment: Emergency rescue and clinical isolation for contagious mange
Weekly medicated skin baths and therapeutic anti-parasitic treatment
Oral antibiotics, pain relief, and skin barrier supplements
Complete fur regrowth and dermatological clearance
Transferred to long-term safe boarding with dedicated caretakers
urgentNeed: Monthly boarding fees, nutritional meals, and routine vet checkups

name: Chinna
diagnosis: Chronic Bilateral Otitis (Severe Ear Infection) & Injured Paw
title: Chinna’s Story: A Fight for a Pain-Free Life
summary: Chinna was found on the streets constantly tilting his head in agony from an untreated double ear infection. Timely veterinary treatment freed him from chronic suffering.
story:
Chinna is a street dog whose small ear infection gradually worsened, affecting both his ears. Left untreated, the infection caused him immense pain and distress. He was found on the streets constantly tilting his head, struggling with the severe pain he was enduring every second.

Chinna received the medical care he desperately needed. His ear canals were thoroughly treated, cleansed, and medicated by our veterinary partners.

His story is a reminder of how a seemingly small health issue, when left unattended on the street, can become a serious threat to an animal’s well-being. Chinna has recovered well and is now living pain-free, with our volunteers actively monitoring him.
treatment: Deep ear canal decontamination under gentle veterinary sedation
Targeted antimicrobial and anti-fungal ear drops course
Wound cleansing and bandage for accompanying paw laceration
Full cessation of head tilt and pain symptoms
Ongoing volunteer spot checks during daily feeding drives
supportGoal: Support Follow-up Care & Street Dog Medical Kits
urgentNeed: Antiseptic supplies, ear drops, and community dog first-aid gear

name: The October 2026 Puppies
title: New Rescue: Vulnerable Orphaned Puppies Given Safe Shelter
summary: Rescued on 20 October 2026, these tiny orphaned pups were brought to safety, warmed, clinically examined, and transitioned onto nutrient-rich puppy formula.
story:
On 20 October 2026, Roksh volunteers responded to an urgent distress call regarding tiny orphaned puppies stranded without shelter or their mother.

The puppies were gently retrieved, given thermal blankets to prevent hypothermia, and taken to the veterinary clinic for a full neonatal assessment.

They are now resting comfortably on clean sofas and pads, being bottle-fed specialized puppy formula, and receiving round-the-clock observation by Roksh caregivers.
treatment: Immediate warming and hydration therapy
Neonatal health screening and glucose stabilization
Deworming and puppy milk replacer diet schedule
Safe indoor foster environment with clean bedding
Pre-vaccination growth monitoring
urgentNeed: Puppy starter food, heating supplies, and upcoming core vaccines
